english.title: Public procession organiser fail to specify details
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a person who organised a public procession held on **(..SPECIFY DATE..), did not satisfy the requirements of section 11(3) of the Public Order Act 1986 as to notice of a proposal to hold a public procession in that the advance written notice did not specify the

(A)_[date when it was intended to hold]_
(B)_[time it was intended to start]_
(C)_[route to be taken by]_
(D)_[name and address of the person or persons it was proposed would organise]_

the said procession.
english.legislation: Contrary to section 11(7)(a) and (10) of the Public Order Act 1986.
